### Introduction
This chapter will introduce the LED light status of our M20EV series equipment
###Schematic diagram
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=cf68144eb136c1777e6cbf261b0a32dd)
#####Status description:
| Indicator | Solid On | Flashing | Off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wi-Fi Indicator (WIFI) | 4G + AP Mode | N/A | 4G + Wi-Fi Mode |
| Network Indicator (NET) | Registered with TTX private platform | Not registered with TTX private platform | 4G and Wi-Fi module error |
| Power Indicator (PWR) | Powered on; camera video normal | Powered on; video lost (camera disconnected, incomplete connection, or parameter mismatch) | N/A |
| Positioning Indicator (GPS) | Positioning successful | Module present but positioning failed | Module missing or faulty |
| Recording Indicator (REC) | Card present and recording | Card present but not recording | Card not detected |
